name: Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering (SVCE)
summary: Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering was started in 1985 at Pennalur, Sriperumbudur, about 37 km from Chennai on the Chennai–Bengaluru highway. It became autonomous in 2016 and its B.E./B.Tech programmes are affiliated to Anna University. Edugate lists the 11 UG programmes on its programmes page.
